limits: All-cell SAE/PCA/NMF fits used inference-control and perturbation expression. This split holds out annotation and reference-score inference conditional on fitted representations, not model training.
The control-only SAE also trained on inference controls, and HVG selection used all cells. It is one sensitivity seed, not an independent test set or completed three-seed control analysis.

Six model fits share cells and marker definitions. Their agreement is not independent biological evidence. Rank64 PCA/NMF and2048 SAE features have unequal capacity and different training objectives. Harmonizing downstream inference does not establish method superiority.
Marker presence and direct-marker detection eligibility differ; an effector feature match cannot establish a gain over an unscorable direct marker panel.

Retrospective joint families do not erase the history of outcome-informed choices. Perturbation severity, compositional effects, cell dependence, construct effects and confounding remain. No novel regulatory mechanism is established.
